title: Change Text Color
prompt: Set the text color of all paragraph elements to blue.

steps: Select paragraph elements using 'p' element selector.

walkthroughSteps: Target paragraph tag using element selector 'p'.
Assign value 'blue' to property 'color'.
Close declaration block.
commonMistakes: Using 'text-color' instead of valid property 'color'.
Forgetting colon or semicolon inside declaration block.

title: Set Background Color
prompt: Set the background color of container elements with class 'card' to lightgray.

walkthroughSteps: Use dot prefix '.card' for class targeting.
Set background-color property to lightgray.
Verify rule syntax.
commonMistakes: Omitting dot '.' prefix for class selector.
Using 'background' shortcut with wrong color syntax.

title: Adjust Font Size
prompt: Set the font size of h1 elements to 24px.

walkthroughSteps: Target h1 element.
Apply font-size property with unit 'px'.
commonMistakes: Omitting unit 'px' after numeric value 24.
Using 'text-size' instead of 'font-size'.

title: Set Font Family
prompt: Apply Arial font with fallback generic sans-serif to the document body.

steps: Specify primary font 'Arial' followed by fallback 'sans-serif'.

walkthroughSteps: Target body selector.
Provide comma-separated font stack inside font-family declaration.
commonMistakes: Forgetting fallback generic font family.
Using quotes around standard single-word font names unnecessarily.

title: Align Text Center
prompt: Center align text content inside header elements.

walkthroughSteps: Select header element.
Set text-align declaration to center.
commonMistakes: Attempting to center block elements using text-align instead of inline text.
Misspelling property as 'align-text'.

title: Remove Link Underline
prompt: Remove default underline text decoration from all anchor links.

walkthroughSteps: Select anchor element 'a'.
Set text-decoration to none.
commonMistakes: Using 'border: none' instead of 'text-decoration: none'.
Setting property value to '0' instead of keyword 'none'.

title: Bold Text Font Weight
prompt: Make text inside elements with class 'highlight' bold using font-weight.

walkthroughSteps: Target selector '.highlight'.
Set font-weight property to keyword 'bold' or numeric '700'.
commonMistakes: Using 'font-style: bold' (bold belongs to font-weight, italic to font-style).
Missing leading dot on class selector.

title: Set Line Height
prompt: Set line height spacing to 1.5 for comfortable reading on paragraph text.

walkthroughSteps: Select 'p' tag.
Apply line-height property with unitless multiplier.
commonMistakes: Adding unnecessary 'px' unit to proportional line-height values.
Confusing line-height with letter-spacing.

title: Set Element Outer Margin
prompt: Apply a 20px margin on all four sides for elements with class 'box'.

walkthroughSteps: Select class '.box'.
Apply shorthand margin rule with single 20px value.
commonMistakes: Confusing outer spacing 'margin' with inner spacing 'padding'.
Specifying 20px four separate times in shorthand when single value applies to all sides.

title: Set Element Inner Padding
prompt: Add 15px inner padding to all sides of button elements.

walkthroughSteps: Select button element.
Set shorthand padding property to 15px.
commonMistakes: Confusing padding with margin.
Forgetting measurement unit 'px'.

title: Add Solid Border
prompt: Add a 1px solid red border around input fields.

walkthroughSteps: Target input selector.
Combine width, style, color in border property declaration.
commonMistakes: Omitting border style 'solid' (border won't render without style).
Incorrect ordering or syntax separators.

title: Rounded Corners with Border Radius
prompt: Make elements with class 'avatar' circular by setting border-radius to 50%.

walkthroughSteps: Select class '.avatar'.
Assign 50% value to border-radius.
commonMistakes: Misspelling property as 'border-corner' or 'corner-radius'.
Omitting percentage sign.

title: Set Explicit Dimensions
prompt: Set width to 300px and height to 200px for container elements with class 'banner'.

walkthroughSteps: Target class selector '.banner'.
Add explicit width and height declarations.
commonMistakes: Combining width and height into illegal shorthand like 'size: 300px 200px'.
Omitting unit 'px'.

title: Display Block Conversion
prompt: Convert span elements with class 'full-width' into block-level elements.

walkthroughSteps: Target qualified selector 'span.full-width'.
Override default inline rendering with display: block.
commonMistakes: Adding space between element and class name ('span .full-width' targets descendant, not qualified span).
Confusing block display with flex display.

title: Hide Element Completely
prompt: Remove elements with class 'hidden' completely from display and document layout flow.

walkthroughSteps: Select '.hidden' class.
Set display property to keyword 'none'.
commonMistakes: Using 'visibility: hidden' which preserves document layout space.
Using 'opacity: 0' which keeps element interactive and rendered in layout.

title: Universal Box Sizing Border Box
prompt: Apply border-box box-sizing to all elements on the page using universal selector.

walkthroughSteps: Select all elements with '*'.
Include padding and borders within total width/height using border-box.
commonMistakes: Using 'content-box' which expands explicit dimensions when padding is added.
Targeting body tag instead of universal '*' selector.

title: Hover State Styling
prompt: Change button background color to darkblue when user hovers over it with mouse.

walkthroughSteps: Append pseudo-class ':hover' to button selector.
Set background-color state override.
commonMistakes: Adding space before colon ('button :hover' selects hovered descendant of button).
Confusing ':hover' with ':active' or ':focus'.

title: Class Selector Targeting
prompt: Style all elements having class name 'alert' with background color pink.

steps: Use period prefix '.alert' for class selection.

walkthroughSteps: Prefix class identifier with dot.
Apply background color declaration.
commonMistakes: Using hash prefix '#' meant for ID selectors.
Capitalizing class name when HTML attribute is lowercase.

title: ID Selector Targeting
prompt: Style single element with unique ID 'main-header' to have text color navy.

steps: Use hash prefix '#main-header' for ID selector.

walkthroughSteps: Prefix unique ID name with '#'.
Set color property declaration.
commonMistakes: Using '.' instead of '#' for ID selector.
Reusing same ID across multiple elements in DOM.

title: Group Multiple Selectors
prompt: Group h1, h2, and h3 heading selectors to share margin-bottom of 10px.

steps: List target selectors 'h1, h2, h3' separated by commas.

walkthroughSteps: Combine multiple tag selectors using comma syntax.
Declare bottom margin rule for group.
commonMistakes: Omitting commas between selectors (creates descendant selector chain instead of group).
Repeating full CSS block per element unnecessarily.

title: Convert Text to Uppercase
prompt: Transform all heading text inside h2 elements to uppercase using CSS.

walkthroughSteps: Target h2 element.
Assign value 'uppercase' to 'text-transform' property.
commonMistakes: Using 'font-style: uppercase' instead of 'text-transform'.
Confusing 'uppercase' with 'capitalize' which only uppercases first letters.

title: Increase Letter Spacing
prompt: Add 2px letter spacing to elements with class 'brand-title'.

walkthroughSteps: Select class '.brand-title'.
Set letter-spacing property with pixel unit.
commonMistakes: Confusing letter-spacing with word-spacing or line-height.
Omitting unit 'px'.

title: Set Element Opacity
prompt: Set the opacity of elements with class 'disabled' to 0.5.

walkthroughSteps: Target class '.disabled'.
Set opacity property to 0.5.
commonMistakes: Using percentage values like '50px' or '50%' (valid opacity ranges from 0 to 1 as decimal).
Confusing opacity with background color alpha transparency.

title: Declare and Use CSS Variable
prompt: Define a custom property '--primary-color' with value '#3498db' on root and use it for button background color.

walkthroughSteps: Define custom property starting with double hyphens '--' inside :root.
Reference custom variable using var() function.
commonMistakes: Omitting double dash '--' prefix when defining CSS variable.
Forgetting var() wrapper function when assigning variable value.

title: Hide Element Overflow
prompt: Prevent content from spilling out of container elements with class 'card' by hiding overflow.

walkthroughSteps: Select class '.card'.
Assign value 'hidden' to overflow property.
commonMistakes: Using 'overflow: scroll' when intentional clipping is required.
Confusing overflow with display: none.

title: Remove Unordered List Bullets
prompt: Remove default list item bullets from navigation lists with class 'nav-list'.

walkthroughSteps: Select '.nav-list' class.
Set list-style property to keyword 'none'.
commonMistakes: Applying 'list-style: none' to 'li' children only instead of parent list wrapper.
Setting property value to '0' instead of 'none'.

title: Set Interactive Pointer Cursor
prompt: Change mouse cursor to a pointer hand when hovering over elements with class 'btn'.

walkthroughSteps: Select class '.btn'.
Assign 'pointer' to cursor property.
commonMistakes: Using 'cursor: hand' which is non-standard or legacy IE syntax.
Applying cursor style inside hover pseudo-class when general element rule suffices.

title: Enable Flexbox Layout
prompt: Convert container elements with class 'flex-container' into flexbox layout containers.

walkthroughSteps: Select '.flex-container' class.
Set display property to keyword 'flex'.
commonMistakes: Using 'flex: 1' on container instead of setting display mode to flex.
Confusing 'display: flex' with 'display: inline-flex'.

title: Set Flex Direction Column
prompt: Stack child items vertically inside flex container with class 'sidebar' using flex-direction.

steps: Ensure display is set to flex.

walkthroughSteps: Set display flex on container.
Set flex-direction to column to align items along vertical axis.
commonMistakes: Forgetting 'display: flex' before using flexbox direction property.
Using 'flex-orientation' instead of 'flex-direction'.

title: Center Content inside Flex Container
prompt: Center child elements both horizontally and vertically inside flex container '.hero'.

approach.example: .hero { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; }

walkthroughSteps: Enable flex layout mode.
Align main axis with justify-content center.
Align cross axis with align-items center.
commonMistakes: Swapping main axis and cross axis alignment properties.
Using text-align: center expecting full vertical flex centering.

title: Apply Relative Positioning
prompt: Set position mode to relative and shift element '.badge' 5px down from its normal position.

walkthroughSteps: Set positioning context to relative.
Apply top offset declaration.
commonMistakes: Using position absolute when relative offset within flow is required.
Omitting unit on top offset value.

title: Position Element Absolutely
prompt: Position element with class 'close-btn' at top 10px and right 10px relative to its positioned container.

walkthroughSteps: Set position mode to absolute.
Declare top and right offset boundaries.
commonMistakes: Forgetting that parent container requires non-static position context.
Confusing absolute positioning with fixed positioning.

title: Fix Header to Top of Viewport
prompt: Fix navbar element with class 'navbar' to top 0 of viewport spanning full width.

walkthroughSteps: Apply fixed positioning relative to browser viewport.
Pin to top-left corner and stretch width to 100%.
commonMistakes: Using position absolute which scrolls with parent document instead of fixing to viewport.
Forgetting left: 0 leading to alignment offsets.

title: Set Stacking Order with Z-Index
prompt: Set z-index of positioned modal container '.modal' to 100 to layer it above other elements.

steps: Ensure non-static positioning context exists (e.g. position: fixed).

walkthroughSteps: Provide explicit non-static positioning.
Set integer stacking order via z-index.
commonMistakes: Attempting z-index on default statically positioned elements.
Adding units like 'px' to numerical z-index values.

title: Add Smooth Color Transition
prompt: Add a smooth 0.3s transition effect to all property changes on button elements.

walkthroughSteps: Select button base rule.
Define property, duration, and timing function shorthand in transition.
commonMistakes: Placing transition rule inside :hover state only causing abrupt un-hover jump.
Forgetting time unit 's' or 'ms'.

title: Add Subtle Box Shadow
prompt: Apply a soft drop shadow with 0 horizontal offset, 4px vertical offset, 8px blur, and black opacity 0.1 to class 'card'.

walkthroughSteps: Target class '.card'.
Set box-shadow parameters in correct order: X-offset, Y-offset, blur-radius, color.
commonMistakes: Confusing box-shadow syntax order.
Using text-shadow on box containers.

title: Set Background Image with Cover Fit
prompt: Set background image 'hero.jpg' for section '.hero-bg' with no repetition and cover sizing.

approach.example: .hero-bg { background-image: url('hero.jpg'); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: cover; }

walkthroughSteps: Set background image target URL using url() wrapper.
Prevent tiling with background-repeat no-repeat.
Scale image to cover container with background-size cover.
commonMistakes: Omitting url() function syntax around image file path.
Using img tag src CSS syntax on background property.

title: Apply Media Query for Mobile Viewports
prompt: Change body background-color to lightblue for screen viewports with max-width 600px.

walkthroughSteps: Create responsive breakpoint rule using @media.
Define conditional CSS rule block inside curly braces.
commonMistakes: Missing parentheses around media condition '(max-width: 600px)'.
Unbalanced closing brackets for nested rules.

title: Custom Input Focus Outline
prompt: Set a custom 2px solid blue focus outline on input element when focused.

walkthroughSteps: Append pseudo-class ':focus' to input target.
Configure outline shorthand width, style, and color.
commonMistakes: Removing default focus outline completely without providing an accessible hover/focus replacement.
Confusing outline with border (outline does not take up box-model space).

title: Center Main Container Layout
prompt: Limit container width to maximum 1200px and center it horizontally using auto margins.

walkthroughSteps: Restrict container width expansion using max-width.
Apply '0 auto' horizontal margin centering trick.
commonMistakes: Using fixed width instead of max-width, breaking responsiveness on mobile devices.
Applying 'margin: auto 0' (vertical auto margins do not center non-flex/grid block elements horizontally).

title: Flexbox Row with Gap
prompt: Type a flex container arranging items in a row with spacing.

walkthroughSteps: gap adds space between flex items without extra margins
align-items controls cross-axis alignment
commonMistakes: Using margins instead of gap
Forgetting align-items for vertical centering

title: CSS Grid Two Columns
prompt: Type a grid container with two equal columns.

walkthroughSteps: fr units divide available space proportionally
Grid gap works like flex gap
commonMistakes: Using px instead of fr for flexible columns
Missing display: grid on the parent

title: Pseudo-class Hover State
prompt: Type a button style with a hover transition.

walkthroughSteps: transition smooths the property change over time
:hover applies only while the pointer is over the element
commonMistakes: Forgetting the transition property
Applying transition only on :hover instead of the base rule

title: Nth-child Selector
prompt: Type a style targeting alternating table rows.

walkthroughSteps: nth-child(even/odd) creates striped rows without extra classes
Keyword formulas are cleaner than numeric formulas here
commonMistakes: Off-by-one confusion between even/odd
Applying to the wrong element level

title: Box Shadow Card
prompt: Type a card style with a soft drop shadow.

steps: Add box-shadow with offset, blur, and color

walkthroughSteps: box-shadow syntax: x-offset y-offset blur color
rgba alpha channel controls shadow softness
commonMistakes: Forgetting the blur value
Using solid black instead of a low-alpha shadow

title: CSS Variables (Custom Properties)
prompt: Type root-level CSS variables and use them.

walkthroughSteps: Custom properties are declared with a -- prefix
var() reads the variable's current value, supports fallbacks
commonMistakes: Forgetting the -- prefix
Defining variables outside :root unnecessarily

title: Media Query Breakpoint
prompt: Type a responsive style that changes layout below 768px.

walkthroughSteps: max-width media queries apply below the given viewport width
Mobile-first vs desktop-first changes which query direction to use
commonMistakes: Wrong comparison (min vs max)
Query placed before the base rule it overrides

title: Absolute Positioning Badge
prompt: Type a notification badge positioned on a parent element.

walkthroughSteps: absolute positioning is relative to the nearest positioned ancestor
Parent needs position: relative to anchor the child
commonMistakes: Forgetting relative positioning on the parent
Using fixed instead of absolute

title: Flexbox Space Between
prompt: Type a header layout with items pushed to opposite ends.

steps: Set display: flex on the container

walkthroughSteps: space-between pushes first/last items to the edges
Remaining space distributes evenly between items
commonMistakes: Confusing space-between with space-around
Missing align-items causing misalignment

title: Transform and Scale on Hover
prompt: Type a hover effect that scales an image slightly.

walkthroughSteps: transform: scale() resizes without affecting layout flow
Transitioning transform is GPU-accelerated and smooth
commonMistakes: Animating width/height instead of transform
Missing the base transition declaration

title: Grid Template Areas
prompt: Type a grid layout using named template areas.

walkthroughSteps: Named areas make grid layouts self-documenting
Each area name must appear as a rectangle in the string
commonMistakes: Area names not matching between template and children
Non-rectangular area shapes

title: Focus-visible Accessibility Style
prompt: Type an accessible focus outline using :focus-visible.

walkthroughSteps: :focus-visible only shows for keyboard navigation, not mouse clicks
outline-offset separates the outline from the element edge
commonMistakes: Removing outline globally without a focus-visible replacement
Using :focus instead, which also triggers on mouse clicks

title: Truncate Text with Ellipsis
prompt: Type a single-line text truncation style.

walkthroughSteps: All three properties are required together for ellipsis truncation
max-width or a fixed width is needed to trigger overflow
commonMistakes: Missing one of the three required properties
No width constraint on the element

title: CSS Animation Keyframes
prompt: Type a simple fade-in keyframe animation.

steps: Apply animation property to an element

walkthroughSteps: @keyframes defines the animation steps by name
animation shorthand sets name, duration, and easing
commonMistakes: Animation name mismatch between keyframes and property
Forgetting duration in the shorthand

title: Flexbox Wrap for Cards
prompt: Type a wrapping flex layout for a card grid.

steps: Set a basis width on each card

walkthroughSteps: flex-wrap allows items to move to new lines
flex: 1 1 200px sets a flexible base width of 200px
commonMistakes: Forgetting flex-wrap causing overflow
Fixed width instead of flex-basis

title: Custom Scrollbar Styling
prompt: Type webkit scrollbar styles for a scrollable container.

walkthroughSteps: ::-webkit-scrollbar is a non-standard but widely supported pseudo-element
Thumb and track can be styled independently
commonMistakes: Forgetting vendor prefix awareness (Firefox uses different properties)
Styling scrollbar globally instead of scoped

title: Object-fit for Images
prompt: Type a style that crops an image to fill its box.

steps: Set a fixed width/height on the image

walkthroughSteps: object-fit: cover crops to fill without distortion
Commonly paired with border-radius for avatars
commonMistakes: Using object-fit: contain when cover is wanted
Missing fixed dimensions on the image

title: CSS Grid Auto-fit Columns
prompt: Type a responsive grid that auto-fits columns based on available space.

walkthroughSteps: auto-fit collapses empty tracks, auto-fill keeps them
minmax sets a flexible min/max size per column
commonMistakes: Confusing auto-fit with auto-fill behavior
Missing minmax causing overly narrow columns

title: Sticky Positioned Header
prompt: Type a header that sticks to the top while scrolling.

walkthroughSteps: sticky behaves like relative until a scroll threshold, then sticks
z-index ensures it layers above scrolling content
commonMistakes: Forgetting top: 0 (sticky needs a threshold value)
Parent with overflow:hidden breaking sticky

title: Attribute Selector Styling
prompt: Type a style targeting inputs by their type attribute.

steps: Use an attribute selector on input

walkthroughSteps: Attribute selectors target elements by attribute value
accent-color themes native checkboxes/radios
commonMistakes: Typos in the attribute value string
Forgetting quotes around the value

title: Clamp for Responsive Font Size
prompt: Type a fluid font size using clamp().

walkthroughSteps: clamp() picks a value between min and max based on the preferred expression
Removes the need for many separate media queries
commonMistakes: Min value greater than max value
Preferred value without a relative unit like vw

title: Backdrop Filter Blur
prompt: Type a frosted-glass overlay effect.

walkthroughSteps: backdrop-filter blurs content behind the element, not the element itself
Needs a translucent background to see the effect
commonMistakes: Opaque background hiding the blur effect
Missing vendor prefix for Safari (-webkit-backdrop-filter)

title: CSS Counters for Numbered Sections
prompt: Type a numbered list using CSS counters instead of markup.

approach.example: .list { counter-reset: item; } li::before { counter-increment: item; content: counter(item); }

walkthroughSteps: counter-reset initializes, counter-increment advances
content: counter() renders the current value
commonMistakes: Resetting the counter inside the item instead of the container
Forgetting counter-increment on the item

title: Aspect Ratio Box
prompt: Type a responsive box that maintains a 16:9 ratio.

walkthroughSteps: aspect-ratio replaces the old padding-hack technique
Height is derived automatically from width
commonMistakes: Setting both height and aspect-ratio conflictingly
Browser support assumptions without checking baseline

title: Multi-column Text Layout
prompt: Type a newspaper-style multi-column text block.

walkthroughSteps: column-count splits text into flowing columns
column-rule draws a divider line between columns
commonMistakes: Using columns for non-flowing layouts (better suited to grid)
Forgetting column-gap making text feel cramped

title: Gradient Border with Background Clip
prompt: Type a card with a gradient border effect.

steps: Set a solid border with transparent color
Use background with padding-box and border-box layering
approach.example: .border-grad { border: 4px solid transparent; background-clip: padding-box, border-box; }

walkthroughSteps: Two background layers with different clip boxes create a gradient border
border-box vs padding-box controls which layer shows through
commonMistakes: Missing transparent border color
Wrong layer order in the background shorthand

title: Grid with Minmax Rows
prompt: Type a grid with flexible row heights using minmax.

walkthroughSteps: grid-auto-rows sizes implicitly created rows
minmax(120px, auto) sets a floor but allows growth
commonMistakes: Fixed row height causing content overflow
Confusing grid-auto-rows with grid-template-rows

title: Will-change Performance Hint
prompt: Type a style hinting the browser about an upcoming animation.

steps: Add will-change to the animated property

walkthroughSteps: will-change lets the browser optimize ahead of a change
Overusing it on many elements can hurt performance instead
commonMistakes: Applying will-change broadly to the whole page
Using it on properties that never actually change

title: Logical Properties for RTL Support
prompt: Type spacing using logical properties instead of physical ones.

walkthroughSteps: Logical properties adapt automatically to text direction (LTR/RTL)
block = vertical axis, inline = horizontal axis in LTR
commonMistakes: Mixing logical and physical properties inconsistently
Assuming inline always means horizontal regardless of writing mode

title: Container Queries
prompt: Type a component style that responds to its container's width.

steps: Set container-type: inline-size on the parent

walkthroughSteps: Container queries respond to a parent's size, not the viewport
container-type must be set before @container rules take effect
commonMistakes: Forgetting container-type on the ancestor
Confusing container queries with media queries

title: Custom Radio/Checkbox Styling
prompt: Type accent-color and appearance overrides for form controls.

steps: Set appearance: none on the input
Add a custom checked style with :checked

walkthroughSteps: appearance: none removes native styling for full control
:checked targets the toggled state
commonMistakes: Forgetting to restyle the checked state entirely
Losing focus visibility after removing appearance

title: Flex Grow and Shrink
prompt: Type flex items with different grow/shrink ratios.

steps: Set flex-grow on a primary item
Set flex-shrink on a secondary item

walkthroughSteps: flex-grow distributes extra space by ratio
flex-shrink controls how items shrink when space is tight
commonMistakes: Confusing grow and shrink values
Using width instead of flex-basis in shorthand

title: Linear Gradient Background
prompt: Type a diagonal two-color gradient background.

walkthroughSteps: Angle defines the gradient direction
Percentage stops control where each color is fully applied
commonMistakes: Forgetting the angle unit (deg)
Only one color stop instead of two

title: Grid Item Placement with Line Numbers
prompt: Type explicit grid item placement using line numbers.

steps: Define a grid on the parent
Place a child using grid-column and grid-row line numbers

walkthroughSteps: Grid lines are numbered starting at 1
The end value is exclusive, like array slicing
commonMistakes: Off-by-one on the end line number
Using span incorrectly mixed with line numbers

title: Not Selector for Exclusions
prompt: Type a style excluding the last child from a border rule.

steps: Select all items with a border
Use :not(:last-child) to exclude the last one

walkthroughSteps: :not() negates a selector inside the parentheses
Common pattern for dividers between list items
commonMistakes: Forgetting :not() and styling every item
Nesting :not() incorrectly with multiple args pre-Level4

title: Text Gradient Effect
prompt: Type a heading with a gradient-filled text color.

steps: Apply background: linear-gradient() to the text
Set background-clip: text and transparent color

walkthroughSteps: background-clip: text clips the background to the glyph shapes
color: transparent reveals the background through the text
commonMistakes: Missing -webkit- prefix for Safari support
Forgetting color: transparent

title: Grid Auto-flow Dense
prompt: Type a grid that fills gaps using dense packing.

walkthroughSteps: dense packing fills earlier gaps left by differently-sized items
Can change visual order away from DOM order
commonMistakes: Using dense when source order must be preserved
Not testing with varied item sizes

title: Custom Focus Ring with Box Shadow
prompt: Type a focus style using box-shadow instead of outline.

walkthroughSteps: box-shadow rings can follow border-radius, unlike outline in some browsers
Still needs :focus-visible to stay keyboard-only
commonMistakes: Removing outline with no replacement at all
Ring color with too little contrast

title: Grid with Subgrid Columns
prompt: Type a nested grid that aligns to its parent's column tracks.

steps: Set child display: grid with grid-template-columns: subgrid

walkthroughSteps: subgrid lets nested grids inherit the parent's track sizing
Child must span the relevant parent columns first
commonMistakes: Forgetting to span the right grid-column range on the child
Using subgrid without a supporting browser baseline check

title: Filter Effects on Images
prompt: Type grayscale and brightness filters with a hover reset.

steps: Apply filter: grayscale() to the base image

walkthroughSteps: Multiple filter functions can be chained in one declaration
Transitioning filter animates smoothly like transform
commonMistakes: Forgetting to reset filter on hover
Chaining filters in a way that fights each other

title: Flexbox Order Property
prompt: Type flex items that reorder visually without changing HTML.

steps: Set order on specific flex items

walkthroughSteps: order controls visual sequence independent of DOM order
Default order value is 0 for all items
commonMistakes: Overusing order in ways that break keyboard tab order
Assuming order changes DOM structure (it doesn't)

title: CSS Clip-path Shapes
prompt: Type a custom polygon clip-path shape.

steps: Use clip-path: polygon() with coordinate pairs

walkthroughSteps: Coordinates are percentages of the element's box
Points are connected in the order listed
commonMistakes: Odd number of coordinate values
Shape points defined in a non-connecting order

title: Scroll Snap Container
prompt: Type a horizontally scrolling gallery with snap points.

walkthroughSteps: scroll-snap-type on the container defines the axis and strictness
scroll-snap-align on children defines the snap point
commonMistakes: Missing overflow-x: auto on the container
Setting snap-align only on some children

title: Custom Property Fallbacks
prompt: Type a var() usage with a fallback value.

steps: Test behavior when the variable is undefined

walkthroughSteps: Second argument to var() is used if the custom property is unset
Useful for theme-safe defaults
commonMistakes: Assuming fallback applies to invalid values, not just unset ones
Comma missing between name and fallback

title: Grid Minmax with Auto-fill
prompt: Type a fixed-slot responsive grid using auto-fill.

walkthroughSteps: auto-fill keeps empty tracks reserved even without content
Useful when consistent slot sizing matters more than filling space
commonMistakes: Expecting auto-fill to collapse empty tracks like auto-fit
Minmax bounds too tight for content

title: Full Responsive Card Grid with Container Queries
prompt: Type a complete component that adapts internally via container queries and externally via grid.

steps: Set up outer grid with auto-fit columns
Mark each card as a query container
Add a @container rule changing internal layout

walkthroughSteps: Outer grid handles page-level responsiveness, container queries handle component-level
Each card must declare itself as a containment context
commonMistakes: Forgetting container-type on the card itself
Conflicting breakpoints between media and container queries

title: Complex Animation with Multiple Keyframe Stops
prompt: Type a bounce animation using several keyframe percentages.

walkthroughSteps: Multiple percentage stops create more natural, non-linear motion
infinite keeps the animation looping continuously
commonMistakes: Uneven stop distribution producing jerky motion
Forgetting infinite when a loop is intended

title: CSS Grid Full Page Layout with Named Lines
prompt: Type a full-page grid using named grid lines instead of areas.

steps: Place items using the named line references

walkthroughSteps: Named lines document layout intent directly in the grid definition
Placement references line names instead of raw numbers
commonMistakes: Mismatched line names between definition and placement
Duplicate line names causing ambiguous references

title: Custom Properties Driven Theme Switcher
prompt: Type a light/dark theme setup using custom properties and a data attribute selector.

walkthroughSteps: Attribute selector scopes an entire variable set to a theme toggle
Components stay theme-agnostic by only referencing variables
commonMistakes: Hardcoding colors in components instead of using variables
Forgetting to define every variable under both themes

title: Advanced Flexbox Holy Grail Layout
prompt: Type a full holy-grail layout using flex with a fixed header/footer and flexible middle row.

steps: Set body to display: flex, flex-direction: column, min-height: 100vh
Make the middle section flex: 1 and itself a flex row
Give sidebars fixed widths and main flex: 1

walkthroughSteps: min-height: 100vh ensures the footer sits at the bottom on short pages
Nesting flex containers lets header/footer stay fixed while the middle grows
commonMistakes: Forgetting min-height causing a collapsed footer
Sidebar without a fixed flex-basis growing unexpectedly

title: Custom Loading Spinner Animation
prompt: Type a CSS-only spinner using border and rotate keyframes.

steps: Style a circle with a transparent top border
Apply animation with linear timing and infinite

walkthroughSteps: A single differently-colored border side creates the spinning indicator illusion
linear timing keeps rotation speed constant
commonMistakes: Using ease instead of linear causing uneven speed
Forgetting border-radius: 50% for a circle

title: Complex Selector Combinators Chain
prompt: Type a rule chaining descendant, child, and sibling combinators together.

steps: Combine a descendant selector, a child selector (>), and a sibling selector (~ or +)

walkthroughSteps: > selects direct children only, + selects the immediate next sibling, ~ selects any following sibling
Chaining combinators expresses precise structural relationships
commonMistakes: Mixing up + (adjacent) and ~ (general sibling)
Overly specific chains that break if markup changes slightly

title: Print Stylesheet with Page Breaks
prompt: Type a print media query controlling page breaks and hiding UI chrome.

steps: Force a page break before a section

walkthroughSteps: break-before: page forces a new printed page at that element
Print styles should hide interactive-only chrome
commonMistakes: Using outdated page-break-before instead of break-before
Forgetting to reset colors for print (dark backgrounds waste ink)

title: Custom Properties with calc() Composition
prompt: Type layout math combining multiple custom properties inside calc().

steps: Define base spacing and multiplier variables
Combine them inside calc() for a derived value

walkthroughSteps: calc() can mix custom properties with literal units
Composing small tokens keeps spacing consistent system-wide
commonMistakes: Missing spaces around calc() operators (required syntax)
Unit mismatches inside calc()

title: Accessible Reduced Motion Handling
prompt: Type an animation that respects the user's reduced-motion preference.

steps: Disable or simplify animation inside that query

walkthroughSteps: prefers-reduced-motion detects a user's OS-level accessibility setting
Reducing motion avoids triggering vestibular discomfort
commonMistakes: Ignoring reduced-motion entirely on decorative animations
Removing all transitions instead of just motion-heavy ones

title: CSS Grid Masonry-style Layout
prompt: Type a Pinterest-style layout using grid-row spans calculated by content.

steps: Set a grid with dense auto-flow
Use grid-row-end: span N to vary item height

walkthroughSteps: A small grid-auto-rows unit lets span values approximate variable heights
grid-auto-flow: dense fills visual gaps between differently-sized items
commonMistakes: Auto-row unit too large, producing chunky height jumps
Span values not derived from actual content height

title: Layered Box Shadows for Depth
prompt: Type a multi-layer box-shadow creating realistic elevation.

steps: Stack several box-shadow values separated by commas
Vary blur and opacity per layer for depth

walkthroughSteps: Multiple shadow layers mimic how real light diffuses at different distances
Commas separate independent shadow layers in one declaration
commonMistakes: Single heavy shadow looking flat and unrealistic
Layers with identical blur/opacity adding no depth

title: CSS Houdini-style Custom Property Typing
prompt: Type a @property rule giving a custom property a type and default.

walkthroughSteps: @property gives custom properties a real type, enabling smooth transitions
Untyped custom properties can't be animated/transitioned directly
commonMistakes: Missing initial-value (required by spec)
Wrong syntax string format

title: Complex Grid Dashboard Layout
prompt: Type a full dashboard layout combining grid-template-areas with responsive collapse.

steps: Add a media query collapsing to a single column on small screens

walkthroughSteps: Redefining grid-template-areas per breakpoint is cleaner than repositioning each child individually
Area names stay consistent; only the template layout changes
commonMistakes: Forgetting to redefine grid-template-columns alongside areas
Area name typos breaking the responsive version silently

title: Full Design Token System with Dark Mode and Motion Preferences
prompt: Type a complete token setup combining theme variables, spacing scale, and reduced-motion handling.

steps: Define a spacing and color token scale in :root
Add dark theme overrides via data attribute

walkthroughSteps: A token system centralizes spacing/color decisions into one source of truth
Feeding --transition-base through prefers-reduced-motion disables motion system-wide without touching every rule
commonMistakes: Hardcoding values elsewhere that bypass the token system
Reduced-motion override placed where specificity doesn't actually win
